brief.text: Create a premium interactive web experience that takes the viewer from inside a high-end gaming PC to the complete machine. […] The goal is not a one-off 3D animation. The goal is a reusable PC anatomy platform […]. Start where the frame begins. End with every physical piece that made it possible.
